checks.name: inventory/settings redact legacy values; only three credential booleans and reference metadata
legacy plaintext never silently calls a provider or authenticates a device
controlled purpose prefixes never expose arbitrary OS variables or cross-purpose references
new plaintext/old clear fields rejected even empty; every failed batch is unchanged
reference-only config persists no new secret bodies and actual resolver readiness is truthful
preview never changes settings; explicit matching migration removes old values and retains callable refs
one mismatching env target blocks entire migration without partial removal
env is re-resolved at actual apply, not trusted from preview readiness
any direct settings mutation bumps opaque revision; stale plan cannot remove credentials
internal original-config hash independently detects drift even if revision was reset in fixture
anonymous/ordinary/operator denied; another admin cannot fetch or apply private plan
closed administrator cannot execute retained preview plan
fresh transaction role rejects stale admin handler before deletion
plan same-key replay is exact; changed mapping conflicts
migration replay never re-removes or mutates settings/audit; new apply key cannot reuse applied plan
independent SQLite concurrent same-key migration commits once with one replay
strict request versions and controlled references reject type/length/scope tricks
unmigrated target edits cannot copy/rewrite plaintext; unrelated explicit theme remains usable
reference-only settings maintain exact action idempotence and configuration versions
explicit clear of a migrated reference disables readiness without falling back
legacy metadata validation retains public HTTPS/no embedded credentials/private IP rejection
after migration all owned DB rows and API/audit receipts contain zero secret canary values or public raw hashes
reserved object keys and malformed existing device structures cannot become implicit credential targets
actual Bearer use rejects whitespace/control/invalid header tokens without trimming; valid exact token preserved
normal edit of migrated device B cannot rewrite unmigrated device A; independent theme remains usable
explicit partial migration removes only matched field via JSON paths; remaining legacy group is still blocked
real dedicated opener rejects301/302/303/307/308 fake response chains with no second request or external network
dedicated direct-response transport retains exact header/body/timeout and does not alter global urllib opener
